BehaviorTree._description: Calibrate the pose of the OAK-D scene camera in base_link from views of a ChArUco board mounted rigidly on the gripper, and draw the solved camera and board poses in the 3D view. Run Generate reBot Calibration Waypoints first, with waypoints that keep the gripper board in the scene camera's view. The URDF places scene_camera_link in world, so convert through world_to_base before setting scene_camera_xyz/rpy. See https://docs.picknik.ai/how_to/robotics_applications/camera_calibration/.

SubTree.input_port: The ChArUco board mounted on the gripper. The default is the bench's A4 print of the standard 7x5 DICT_4X4_50 board (35 mm squares, 26 mm markers).
